The following table refers for interactions while Zaahen is dashing:

abilities.name: Cultivation of War

evidence.quote: Periodically, if Zaahen would take lethal damage while at maximum stacks of Determination, he refreshes its duration and enters resurrection for 4 seconds: becoming invulnerable, untargetable, and unable to act.

Periodically, if Zaahen would take lethal damage while at maximum stacks of Determination, he refreshes its duration and enters resurrection for 4 seconds: becoming invulnerable, untargetable, and unable to act.

Periodically, if Zaahen would take lethal damage while at maximum stacks of Determination, he refreshes its duration and enters resurrection for 4 seconds: becoming invulnerable, untargetable, and unable to act.

notes: The untargetability from the resurrection does not destroy in-flight projectiles.
Invulnerability will prevent stacks from being generated, as no damage is dealt.
Spell shield will not prevent stacks from being generated, even if no damage is dealt.

abilities.name: The Darkin Glaive

evidence.quote: Recast: Zaahen empowers his next basic attack within 4 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain 25 bonus range, deal bonus physical damage and knock up the target for 0.75 seconds.
If the target was a champion, minion, or monster, he also heals himself.

notes: Spell shield will only block the knock up from the recast.

Since the healing is granted on-attack, parrying effects will not prevent Zaahen from gaining the heal. Otherwise, parrying effects will negate all other aspects of The Darkin Glaive's attacks while consuming them.

The first cast's double-strike attack:
  - Rolls critical strike once for both strikes.
  - Does not cause Zaahen to attack twice.
    - Effects that trigger on-attack or interact with the attack windup will only trigger once and thus do not interact with The Darkin Glaive. (e.g. Lethal Tempo, Hail of Blades).
  - Will consume Bone Plating once.
    - If the first strike triggers the rune, the second one will get blocked by it.
    - If the first strike is blocked by the rune, the second one will not.

abilities.name: Grim Deliverance

evidence.quote: Active: Zaahen gains crowd control immunity over the cast time, then launches with displacement immunity into the air to the target location.
Active: Zaahen gains crowd control immunity over the cast time, then launches with displacement immunity into the air to the target location.
He retains these effects as well as the displacement immunity during the delay before the slam and for up-to an additional 0.25 seconds afterwards.
He then slams his glaive down after a 0.6-second delay, unleashing a shockwave that deals physical damage to nearby enemies and heals him for each champion hit.

notes: The lockout, damage reduction, and displacement immunity may last for up to an additional 0.25 seconds after the slam due to fuzziness.
Spell shield will block the damage but not the heal.

If Zaahen blinks or has his dash otherwise interrupted while ascending into the air, Grim Deliverance's effects are canceled; he will not slam the ground and will not update his animations correctly, additionally, he will be able to move during the lockout.
Zaahen will transition from having total crowd control immunity during the cast time, to having displacement immunity during the dash and the slam delay.

abilities.name: Dreaded Return

evidence.quote: Upon reaching maximum range, all enemies hit are dealt physical damage, stunned for 0.25 seconds, and pulled 225 units toward Zaahen.
Upon reaching maximum range, all enemies hit are dealt physical damage, stunned for 0.25 seconds, and pulled 225 units toward Zaahen.

notes: Spell shield will block both passes, as well as the second one individually if circumstances permit.
Intercepting the initial projectile will instantly trigger Dreaded Return's pull.
Displacement immunity will not resist the application of the stun.
The damage, stun, and pull from hitting the target do not occur if Zaahen is dead by the time the missile reaches maximum range.
The projectile is shown on the minimap and Dreaded Return can be cast targeting the minimap.
